meta_rows: Derived: Regular medication - Drugs for urinary frequency, enuresis, and incontinence (postal questionnaire) at age 60-64 years

This variable refers to derived regular medication data. This was asked at 1977, 1982, 1989, 1999, 2006-10, 2015 and 2023 data collection waves. Medication in the last 24 hours was only asked at the 2006-10 nurse schedule.
